children: may extend bounce into a range of $102.54-$104.02 per barrel, driven by a wave c.

A retracement analysis reveals this wave has travelled above the resistance at $101.06. The next resistance will be at $102.54, a break above which could open the way towards the zone of $104.02-$105.85.
As the third leg of a bounce from $96.55, this wave c is capable of travelling far above the peak of the wave a near $104.02.
A break below $102.54, now a support, may cause a fall to $99.23. On the daily chart, the market has stabilised twice around a support at $98.
The stabilisation suggests the formation of a small double-bottom, which will be confirmed when the market breaks $102.67.
